package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	httptransport "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http"
	adminhandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	apihandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	privatehandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
)

// This regression uses the production root router and protected HealthHandler.
// PostgreSQL is opt-in through the existing disposable integration fixture.
func TestT15DenseReadinessFlagOffPendingV2(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newTeacherDecisionIntegrationFixture(t)
	repository := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: fixture.pool}
	job := acceptDenseJob(t, repository, fixture, uuid.NewString(), 1)
	before := t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID)
	require.ErrorIs(t, repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(context.Background()), ErrDenseTeacherOrderingDisabledWithPendingV2)
	const token = "t15-synthetic-readiness-token"
	router := httptransport.NewRouter(httptransport.RouterDependencies{
		APIPersonalTeacher:   &apihandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{},
		APITeacherDialog:     &apihandlers.TeacherDialogHandler{},
		AdminPersonalTeacher: &adminhandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{},
		PrivateHealth:        t15ReadinessHandler(repository),
		InternalToken:        token,
	})
	for _, provided := range []string{"", "wrong-synthetic-token", token + " "} {
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/readyz", nil)
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", provided)
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
		require.Equal(t, http.StatusForbidden, response.Code)
	}
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/readyz", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, response.Code,
		"a durable V2 job cannot drain while dense claiming is disabled")
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"status":"not ready","error_code":"dense_teacher_ordering_disabled_with_pending_v2"}`, response.Body.String())
	for _, private := range []string{token, job.Request.EventID, job.Request.SourceMessageID, fixture.studentID, fixture.teacherID} {
		require.NotContains(t, response.Body.String(), private)
	}
	require.Equal(t, before, t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID), "readiness must not modify durable facts")
	repository.DenseOrderingEnabled = true
	require.NoError(t, repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(context.Background()))
	require.Equal(t, before, t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID))
}

func t15ReadinessHandler(repository TeacherDialogJobRepository) *privatehandlers.HealthHandler {
	return &privatehandlers.HealthHandler{
		Ready: repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness,
		ReadinessFailureCode: func(err error) string {
			if errors.Is(err, ErrDenseTeacherOrderingDisabledWithPendingV2) {
				return "dense_teacher_ordering_disabled_with_pending_v2"
			}
			return ""
		},
	}
}

func TestT15DenseReadinessPendingStates(t *testing.T) {
	for _, state := range []string{"processing", "delivery_pending", "unknown", "partial", "committed_unreconciled"} {
		t.Run(state, func(t *testing.T) {
			fixture := newTeacherDecisionIntegrationFixture(t)
			repository := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: fixture.pool, DenseOrderingEnabled: true}
			job := acceptDenseJob(t, repository, fixture, uuid.NewString(), 1)
			claimed, ok := claimDenseJob(t, repository, "t15-readiness-worker", time.Now().UTC())
			require.True(t, ok)
			switch state {
			case "processing":
			case "delivery_pending":
				decision, event := fixture.decision(uuid.NewString(), job.Request.EventID, domain.LearningContextGeneral, "", "", job.Request.DialogID)
				require.NoError(t, repository.SaveGenerated(context.Background(), job.Request.EventID, claimed.ClaimToken, decision, event, "t15-private-pending-body", uuid.NewString(), time.Now().UTC()))
				now := time.Now().UTC()
				require.NoError(t, repository.Retry(context.Background(), job.Request.EventID, claimed.ClaimToken, "delivery_unavailable", now.Add(time.Minute), now))
			default:
				require.NoError(t, repository.MarkReconciliation(context.Background(), job.Request.EventID, claimed.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherTurnReconciliationState(state), "t15_unresolved", time.Now().UTC()))
			}
			before := t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID)
			repository.DenseOrderingEnabled = false
			err := repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(context.Background())
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrDenseTeacherOrderingDisabledWithPendingV2)
			require.EqualError(t, err, "dense_teacher_ordering_disabled_with_pending_v2")
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			t15ReadinessHandler(repository).Readyz(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/readyz", nil))
			require.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, response.Code)
			require.JSONEq(t, `{"status":"not ready","error_code":"dense_teacher_ordering_disabled_with_pending_v2"}`, response.Body.String())
			require.Equal(t, before, t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID))
			repository.DenseOrderingEnabled = true
			require.NoError(t, repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(context.Background()))
			require.Equal(t, before, t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID))
		})
	}
}

func TestT15DenseReadinessNoPendingV2(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newTeacherDecisionIntegrationFixture(t)
	repository := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: fixture.pool}
	require.NoError(t, repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(context.Background()))
	request := domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		EventID: uuid.NewString(), DialogID: uuid.NewString(), EventSequence: 1,
		SourceMessageID: uuid.NewString(), SourceSequence: 1, StudentID: fixture.studentID,
		PersonalTeacherID: fixture.teacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
		SourceChannel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC(),
	}
	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(request, time.Now().UTC())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	accepted, err := repository.Accept(context.Background(), job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, accepted)
	before := t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID)
	require.NoError(t, repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(context.Background()))
	require.Equal(t, before, t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID))
}

func TestT15DenseReadinessDeliveredHistory(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newTeacherDecisionIntegrationFixture(t)
	repository := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: fixture.pool, DenseOrderingEnabled: true}
	job := acceptDenseJob(t, repository, fixture, uuid.NewString(), 1)
	claimed, ok := claimDenseJob(t, repository, "t15-terminal-worker", time.Now().UTC())
	require.True(t, ok)
	decision, event := fixture.decision(uuid.NewString(), job.Request.EventID, domain.LearningContextGeneral, "", "", job.Request.DialogID)
	require.NoError(t, repository.SaveGenerated(context.Background(), job.Request.EventID, claimed.ClaimToken, decision, event, "t15-delivered-response", uuid.NewString(), time.Now().UTC()))
	require.NoError(t, repository.CompleteDelivery(context.Background(), job.Request.EventID, claimed.ClaimToken, uuid.NewString(), time.Now().UTC()))
	before := t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID)
	repository.DenseOrderingEnabled = false
	require.NoError(t, repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(context.Background()))
	require.Equal(t, before, t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID))
}

func TestT15DenseReadinessUnavailableRepository(t *testing.T) {
	repository := TeacherDialogJobRepository{}
	require.Error(t, repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(context.Background()))
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	t15ReadinessHandler(repository).Readyz(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/readyz", nil))
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, response.Code)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"status":"not ready"}`, response.Body.String())
}

func TestT15DenseReadinessQueryFailuresStayClosed(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newTeacherDecisionIntegrationFixture(t)
	repository := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: fixture.pool}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	require.ErrorIs(t, repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(ctx), context.Canceled)

	// A separate read-only connection hides application tables through its
	// search path; this verifies missing-table failure without schema mutation.
	config := fixture.pool.Config()
	config.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams["search_path"] = "pg_catalog"
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(context.Background(), config)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(pool.Close)
	repository.Pool = pool
	err = repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(context.Background())
	var postgresError *pgconn.PgError
	require.ErrorAs(t, err, &postgresError)
	require.Equal(t, "42P01", postgresError.Code)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	t15ReadinessHandler(repository).Readyz(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/readyz", nil))
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, response.Code)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"status":"not ready"}`, response.Body.String())
}

// This is a synthetic HISTORICAL terminal table fixture using the existing
// proof-backed persistence contract. It verifies only the readiness filter;
// it does not prove Student effect absence or authorize skipping blocked work.
func TestT15DenseReadinessSyntheticCompletedHistory(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newTeacherDecisionIntegrationFixture(t)
	repository := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: fixture.pool, DenseOrderingEnabled: true}
	job := acceptDenseJob(t, repository, fixture, uuid.NewString(), 1)
	claimed, ok := claimDenseJob(t, repository, "t15-synthetic-history-worker", time.Now().UTC())
	require.True(t, ok)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	proof := domain.TeacherDialogNoEffectProof{
		ID: uuid.NewString(), SourceEventID: job.Request.EventID, TeacherJobID: claimed.TeacherJobID,
		StudentCommandID: uuid.NewString(), RecordedAt: now,
	}
	outcome := domain.TeacherDialogRecoverableOutcome{
		ID: uuid.NewString(), SourceEventID: job.Request.EventID, TeacherJobID: claimed.TeacherJobID,
		TurnCorrelationID: job.Request.CorrelationID, CreatedAt: now,
	}
	require.NoError(t, repository.RecordFailedNoEffect(context.Background(), job.Request.EventID, claimed.ClaimToken, proof, outcome, "synthetic_historical_absence", now))
	before := t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID)
	repository.DenseOrderingEnabled = false
	require.NoError(t, repository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(context.Background()))
	require.Equal(t, before, t15ReadinessFacts(t, repository, fixture.teacherID))
}

func t15ReadinessFacts(t *testing.T, repository TeacherDialogJobRepository, teacherID string) string {
	t.Helper()
	var facts string
	require.NoError(t, repository.Pool.QueryRow(context.Background(), `
SELECT json_build_object(
    'jobs', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j) ORDER BY j.event_id), '[]'::jsonb)
             FROM teacher_dialog_job j WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1),
    'cursors', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.dialog_id), '[]'::jsonb)
                FROM teacher_dialog_turn_cursor c WHERE dialog_id IN
                     (SELECT dialog_id FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1)),
    'proofs', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.source_event_id), '[]'::jsonb)
               FROM teacher_dialog_turn_proof p WHERE source_event_id IN
                    (SELECT event_id FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1)),
    'outcomes', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) ORDER BY o.source_event_id), '[]'::jsonb)
                 FROM teacher_dialog_turn_outcome o WHERE source_event_id IN
                      (SELECT event_id FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1))
)::text`, teacherID).Scan(&facts))
	return facts
}
